statement: The system shall provide railways with one interoperable communications system that works reliably across borders and across different operators.

The system shall support emergency and priority communications that are not disrupted by lower-priority traffic.
Success shall be measured by reliable coverage and call setup, especially along routes and in operational hotspots.
